text:
Sam (newhire): Hey team — I'm following the Python quickstart in the repo and my first call is failing with a 403. New account, fresh workspace. Example: 

Sam (newhire): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('hello')
print(resp)
```

Sam (newhire): Error: {\"error\": \"403 Forbidden\", \"message\": \"workspace inactive: billing required to enable API usage\"}

Sam (newhire): I already used the web quickstart to create a workspace and an API key. Did I miss a step? :confused:

DevBot: Heads up — newly created workspaces sometimes get gated until billing/trial activation. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspace/billing

Maya (devex): Hi Sam — can you paste the exact curl you ran (or how you set REDWOOD_API_KEY)? Sometimes folks accidentally use the workspace ID instead of the API key. Also which SDK version?

Sam (newhire): I exported REDWOOD_API_KEY=ws_ABC123 thinking that's the key. I grabbed the ID from the URL. Oops. Here's what I tried: 

Sam (newhire): ```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=ws_ABC123
python quickstart.py
```

Chris (backend): Yep that's the issue — ws_... is the workspace ID. The API key starts with sk_ or rk_ (depends on role). If a 403 says billing required it's possible the workspace exists but never had billing/trial enabled. Lee from billing can confirm.

Lee (billing): Confirming — new orgs sometimes need trial activation. If you created the workspace with a company email you'll see a \"Start free trial\" banner in the Billing page. Add a card or request trial enablement and toggle \"Enable API usage\". If you want, DM me the workspace ID and I'll flip it — but you should be able to do it in Console > Billing.

Maya (devex): Quick checklist for next steps: 
1) Ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY is an API key (sk_/rk_), not a workspace id. 
2) Check Console > Billing for trial/enable flags. 
3) If using SDK <0.9.3 upgrade (`pip install --upgrade redwood-sdk`) — there was a retry behavior bug with auth failures that made debugging noisy.

Sam (newhire): Fixed the env var (used sk_ key) and added a card. Re-ran: 

Sam (newhire): ```bash
curl -s -X POST 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_...\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{\"input\":\"say hi\"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq
```

Sam (newhire): Response: `{\"output\": \"Hi! How can I help today?\"}` 

Sam (newhire): First successful call! 🎉 Thanks everyone.

Maya (devex): Nice. Two followups: 
- Chris will open an SDK bug to improve the error message when a workspace is gated (so it suggests billing console link). 
- We'll update the quickstart README to show an example of API key vs workspace id and a note about billing gating.

Chris (backend): Filed https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2312 — will include better text and catch 403 -> \"workspace requires billing activation\" on client error. Also removing noisy retries in auth path is queued.

Lee (billing): If anyone else hits this, DM me the workspace slug and I can expedite trial enablement for test accounts.

Sam (newhire): Appreciate it — saved me a lot of time. Closing the thread. :rocket:
